newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon reserves rise at end of January.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon reserves rise at end of January.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose by $104.62 million in the second half of January to $6,140.55 million, according to the central bank's bi-monthly balance sheet published on Monday.
Gross reserves gained $150.28 million in the first half of January to $6,035.93 million.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves, but banking sources told Reuters they stood at $4,100 million at the end of January.
Net reserves were $4,030 million at mid-January. They stood at $4,015 million at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 million a year earlier. They were $2,732 million at the end of 1994.
